title: Emrys and the Orbit
author: Ines Coldharbour
blurb: Bram Halloran, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
